interpretations: Group expenses by non-null link_to_budget, sum cost per group, and take the plain average of those group totals, with the comparison strictly greater than (>) that average
Same as above, but lines whose total is greater than or equal to (>=) the average are also kept
Include expenses with NULL link_to_budget as one additional group when computing per-line totals and the average
Exclude expenses with NULL link_to_budget from all calculations
Include expense groups whose link_to_budget has no matching budget row
Keep only expense groups whose link_to_budget matches an existing budget row, by joining to budget
Use all expenses regardless of the approved flag
Use only approved expenses (approved = 'true') for totals and counts
Use only unapproved expenses for totals and counts
Per-line total is the sum of expense.cost, not budget.spent
Per-line total is budget.spent, with expenses used only to select lines that have at least one expense
Average is computed only over budget lines with at least one expense, as stated, excluding budget lines with no expenses
Average is computed over all budget lines, with zero totals for lines that have no expenses
Count of expenses is the number of expense rows per line, summed over the above-average lines
Count of expenses is the number of expense rows with non-null cost
Count of expenses is the number of distinct expense_id values
Output one row with three columns: average of the above-average totals, sum of expense counts, and average excess over the overall average
Average excess is the mean of (line total − overall average) over the above-average lines
Average excess is reported as a percentage or ratio over the overall average instead of a dollar amount
Average of totals is the mean of the per-line totals of the above-average lines
Average of totals is the total cost of those lines divided by the total number of their expenses (cost per expense)
Overall average is the total cost of all expenses divided by the number of expenses (average per expense) instead of the average per line
If no line is above the average, return one row with NULL or zero values
If no line is above the average, return no rows
Expenses with NULL cost are treated as zero in totals
Expenses with NULL cost are ignored in totals and counts
queries:
SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY link_to_budget
HAVING SUM(cost) > (
    SELECT AVG(group_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(cost) AS group_total
        FROM expense
        WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY link_to_budget
    )
);
SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);
SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget)
SELECT e.link_to_budget
FROM expense e
LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.link_to_budget;
SELECT e.link_to_budget
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.link_to_budget;
